# Copyright

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Copyright`](gmeow-Copyright.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Copyright>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The reified copyright over a work — binding the work, its holder(s), the copyright year and the human-readable notice. Its status (in-copyright, public-domain, …) is a [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) value aligned to RightsStatements.org / PREMIS.
